QUOTE: "Calls `client.createPost` once more. ... On failure, either removes the post (for the three terminal errors) or sets `failed: true` again."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states retryFailedPost makes a single new createPost call and on failure removes the post for the three terminal errors or marks it failed again; "once more" plus the no-retry framing covers the no-loop/no-backoff claim.
